problem: The frozen full-development profile assigns 67 of 110 Judge-wrong cases to reference-document-retrieved-but-answer-wrong, but the category conflates answer exposure, evidence selection, and final synthesis.
simplest_baseline: Reuse the 67 frozen traces and test answer-atom coverage first in all visible reference content and then only in cited reference content. Make no provider, search, or Judge call.
hypothesis: At least 60% of the 67 cases hide one or more literal answer atoms despite reference-document arrival, which would route the next mechanism to evidence exposure or opening.
changed_mechanisms: replace the aggregate downstream failure label with a hash-bound offline arrival-to-synthesis funnel
anti_claim: This is a posthoc gold-aware localization tool, not a runtime harness improvement, training result, or model-capability gain.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: More research workers cannot repair answer spans that never entered the visible context; localize exposure before considering context isolation or delegation.
Compression and synthesis changes are justified only if answer-bearing evidence was actually visible and selected in the frozen traces.
Crawler breadth is not the smallest response to a profile already dominated by cases with some reference-document arrival; distinguish summary exposure from publisher synthesis first.
Parallel branch expansion targets missing research branches, while the selected 67-case cohort already has reference arrival by construction.

frozen_controls: the exact 67 cases selected by failure-profile hash and query-ID hash
the final 175-query v10 summary and every run hash
the same development gold and calibrated Judge result
union of gold and evidence docids as the reference set
saved reference snippets plus successful reference opens as visible content
all-answer-atom literal coverage and bracketed known-docid citation parsing
zero provider, online search, new Judge, GPU, or sealed-holdout access
next_action: Validate and commit the registered funnel implementation, then execute it once on the hash-bound saved traces. Route only from the frozen 60% thresholds; do not introduce a runtime mechanism in the same loop.
claim_boundary: This loop may identify a dominant downstream evidence stage on 67 development failures using saved traces. It cannot establish an effectiveness gain, official benchmark accuracy, sealed-holdout performance, framework superiority, or model-capability improvement.
